title: Is a Gym Membership Worth It?
summary: How a $50 monthly gym membership compares with a $12 drop-in pass, what each visit really costs, where it breaks even at 5 visits a month, and the January trap. Host: the cat

pages.section: Hook: $50 a month or $12 a visit?
pages.say: A gym membership costs $50 a month. A drop-in pass costs $12 a visit. Which one is cheaper depends on one number: how often you actually go.

beats.object: a price tag on a gym key card
beats.action: swings onto the floor line as $50 pops beside it, the cat host in shock
drops in beside the card with a $12 price tag swaying
switches to think, paw on chin, looking between the two
pops up between them with a question mark on the month

pages.section: Rule: divide the fee by your visits
pages.say: Split the $50 by the visits you make. Go 2 times a month and each visit costs $25. Go 4 times and it's $12.50, about the same as a drop-in pass.

beats.action: drops onto the floor line, the cat host points at it
split out of the pouch as $25 pops above each
replace the two, each smaller, $12.50 counts down beside them
slides in next to the coins, the cat host shrugs

pages.section: Pattern: the more you go, the cheaper each visit
pages.say: Go 8 times a month and each visit drops to $6.25. Go 12 times and it's about $4.17. The membership rewards regulars.

beats.object: a bar chart of four rounded bars
beats.action: rises bar by bar: $25, $12.50, then $6.25
pops in shortest at about $4.17, the cat host cheers
wobbles beside the shortest bar as a mint pill sticks on

pages.say: Now compare with drop-ins. 4 drop-ins cost $48, still under $50. 5 drop-ins cost $60, more than the membership. So 5 visits a month is the break-even.

beats.action: writes the row 4 × $12 and the total counts up to $48
adds the row 5 × $12 and counts up to $60, the cat host gasps
coins drop in while its total counts up to $50 under the $60 row
slams down on the calculation, the cat host nods

pages.say: The trap is January. Pay $50 a month for a year and that's $600. If you stop going by March, 10 months, $500, go to waste.

beats.action: flips to January as a receipt prints $600 for the year
flips on to March, the gym key card slides into a drawer
fly out of the money pouch one by one while $500 counts up in coral
slams onto the receipt, the cat host frowns sadly

pages.say: So count your real visits for a month first. 5 or more a month, get the membership. Fewer than 5, keep paying $12 a visit.

beats.action: prints row one, the cat host holds an open book
prints row two in mint
prints row three in yellow
slams onto the receipt, the cat host waves goodbye
